from pathlib import Path
program = '''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    # The instruction marker is the largest straight, one-cell-wide L component.
    marker = None
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        want={(r0,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)}
        for corner in ((r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)):
            # Check a one-cell-thick L with its arms meeting at this bbox corner.
            rr,cc=corner
            rows=set(r for r,c in cells if r==rr)
            cols=set(c for r,c in cells if c==cc)
            arm={(rr,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1)}
            if set(cells)==arm and len(cells)==(r1-r0+1)+(c1-c0+1)-1:
                marker=(color,cells,corner)
                break
        if marker:
            break
    if marker is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mc,mcells,(cr,cc)=marker
    mr=[r for r,c in mcells]; mcol=[c for r,c in mcells]
    r0,r1=min(mr),max(mr); c0,c1=min(mcol),max(mcol)
    # Identify which directions the L arms extend from its corner.
    vr = -1 if cr==r0 else 1
    hc = -1 if cc==c0 else 1
    # Open quadrant points opposite the two arms.
    dr=-vr; dc=-hc
    candidates=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color==mc or min(r for r,c in cells)==0 or max(r for r,c in cells)==h-1 or min(c for r,c in cells)==0 or max(c for r,c in cells)==w-1:
            continue
        # Keep components whose center is inside the open quadrant.
        y=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); x=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
        if (y-cr)*dr <= 0 or (x-cc)*dc <= 0:
            continue
        # Distance of the center from the diagonal bisector of that quadrant.
        dev=abs((y-cr)*dr-(x-cc)*dc)
        candidates.append((dev, color, cells))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,target_color,target=min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=mc
    return out
'''
